annotation.title_clean: Edge-Enabled Intelligence for Next Generation Surgical Robotics: Real-Time Optimization and Responsible Innovation
annotation.title_en: Edge-Enabled Intelligence for Next Generation Surgical Robotics: Real-Time Optimization and Responsible Innovation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sadaf, R.; Reddy, C.K.K.; Anisha, P.R.; Gorak, T.; Sadaf, J.; Doss, S.
annotation.venue: Next-Generation Insights on Autonomous Surgical Robotics (IGI Global)
annotation.summary_en: Book chapter abstract on integrating edge intelligence into real-time surgical robotics, covering distributed, hierarchical and hybrid edge-cloud architectures, optimization challenges and ethical concerns. Mainly technical; governance content is limited to a passing mention of responsible innovation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Edge computing enables low-latency, secure, real-time processing and localized decision-making at the surgical site.
ML/AI models at the network edge can improve reliability in surgical environments.
Reviews distributed edge, hierarchical edge and hybrid edge-cloud architectures for coordinating robotic instruments and sensors.
Notes ethical concerns accompanying edge-enabled surgical robotics.
